The investigator shares with you the reports of his fellows in the Central Shroud─it would appear that the Continental Circus's wicked scheme was not restricted to Hyrstmill. Make your way to Bentbranch Meadows, and rendezvous with the Adventurers' Guild investigator.

entries.en: You join the investigator in Bentbranch, and he grimly explains the situation. Though no children have yet been transformed, it will only be a matter of time before they fall prey to the charms─and curses─of the wily imps. Even as the adventurer contemplates a means by which you might shield the younglings from the illusionists' sinister spells, you hear a voice beckoning you hither. Leave the investigator to his desperate deliberations, and search for the owner of the disembodied voice.
entries.fr: Vous avez discuté avec l'enquêteur, qui vous a appris que les imps du Cirque intercontinental n'avaient pas encore fait de victimes dans cette région. Il veut cependant que vous trouviez au plus vite un moyen de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues. Mais alors que vous commenciez à y réfléchir, une voix familière a retenti. Le seul problème, c'est que vous êtes apparemment <if(gnum4,la seule,le seul)> à l'avoir entendue... Retrouvez la personne qui vous a parlé<nbsp>!

entries.en: You locate the owner of the voice─the pumpkin-headed stranger─and she once more provides a solution to your occult quandary. She offers you the use of an enchanted broom, whose magic will allow you to sweep away the ability to fling transfiguration curses. Ride the witch's broom around Bentbranch Meadows, and cast Silencing Cant on all the unusual imps you can find.

entries.fr: Vous avez empêché les imps de s'en prendre aux enfants grâce à votre sort. Retournez voir l'enquêteur pour tout lui raconter.

entries.en: The investigator is impressed by your unexpected solution, but laments that it came too late to save one little girl. Considering the case in Hyrstmill, he muses, it is likely that the missing Miqo'te has already been subjected to a fiendish transformation. Speak with the pumpkin-headed apparition once more, and request another batch of curse-breaking cookies.
entries.fr: Vous avez discuté avec l'enquêteur, qui vous a expliqué qu'une petite fille manquait à l'appel. Si toutes ces affaires sont liées, elle a peut-être été changée en monstre. Partez à la recherche de la femme à tête de citrouille au ranch de Brancharquée, elle pourra peut-être vous aider.
entries.ja: 冒険者ギルドの調査員に報告した。ひとりだけ、魔物にヘンシンさせられてしまった子がいるようだ。ベントブランチ牧場の「パンプキンヘッドの女」に相談しよう。

entries.en: You bring your request to the pumpkin-headed stranger, and she explains that her cookies must be eaten soon after the transformation takes place to have any effect. She sadly concludes that by the time another batch was baked it would be far too late. It is then that the apparition presents you with another possibility: if you were to burn the witch's broom and sprinkle its ashes over the girl, then the curse would be broken. Look for a fire in which to cast the broom, and then gather its sooty remains.
entries.fr: Vous avez retrouvé la femme à tête de citrouille. Elle vous a expliqué que <frnoun(EventItem,2,2001896,2,1)> qu'elle vous avait confiés ne faisaient effet qu'en étant consommés im<->mé<->dia<->te<->ment après transformation. Il ne lui en reste malheureusement plus et il serait trop tard, même si elle en cuisinait d'autres maintenant. Elle vous a conseillé de brûler votre <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001897,1,1)> en le jetant dans <frnoun(EObj,2,2006593,1,1)>. Quand ce sera fait, n'oubliez pas de récupérer les cendres du balai.

entries.en:
You return to the investigator to find a relieved T'danafa reunited with her daughter. She thanks you profusely for rescuing T'maritaa, before turning to scold her wayward child. Meanwhile, the lead conspirators of the Continental Circus begin to suspect that someone has learned the trick of dispelling their transformation magicks. Fearing that their identities will be exposed, they choose to abandon their malefic plot and focus on maintaining their entertainers' masquerade.

The pumpkin-headed apparition heralds you as the savior of All Saints' Wake, and rewards you with a new witch's broom. Ride your new prize to the clouds and beyond as you enjoy the remainder of the festival!
